palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Shared shell colors. The settings editor stays neutral so colors can always be repaired.

surface.title: Liquid surface
surface.description: Single solid fill for the liquid field and bar.

foreground.title: Foreground
foreground.description: Primary text and active workspace color.

gradientEnabled.title: Gradients
gradientEnabled.description: Fill each wash state with its gradient. Off, each state uses its solid start color.

iconFontFamily.title: Icon font
iconFontFamily.description: Active Nerd Font for shell icons; changes live without changing text typography.

bar.title: Bar
bar.description: Background treatment of the top bar.

solidBackground.title: Solid background
solidBackground.description: Fill and join the bar to the liquid field. Its top corners follow the display outline and its side-edge corners use the display radius. Drawers touching a solid bar attach at its bottom; with a transparent background, top drawers attach to the screen edge.

show.title: Show clock
show.description: Display the clock in the center of the bar.

format.title: Format
format.description: Choose a 24-hour clock or a 12-hour clock with AM/PM.

fontSize.title: Size
fontSize.description: Clock text size in logical pixels; the bar grows to keep it visible.

fontWeight.title: Weight
fontWeight.description: Clock font weight from thin to black.

indicators.title: Indicators
indicators.description: System status icons on the right side of the bar.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
bluetooth.description: Show the Bluetooth adapter status icon.

network.title: Network
network.description: Show the Wi-Fi or wired network status icon.

volume.title: Volume output
volume.description: Show the default sink volume icon.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.description: Show the default source volume icon.

volumePercentage.title: Show percentage
volumePercentage.description: Show the volume percentage next to the volume icons. The OSD shows it whenever the volume changes.

percentageOnHover.title: Show percentage on hover
percentageOnHover.description: Reveal a hidden volume or battery percentage when the pointer rests on its icon.

battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Battery status on the right side of the bar.

show.title: Battery
show.description: Show the battery icon. Hidden automatically on systems without a battery.

percentage.title: Show percentage
percentage.description: Show the battery percentage next to the icon always, never, or only while the battery is low and discharging.

lowThreshold.title: Low battery level
lowThreshold.description: A discharging battery at or below this level counts as low.

lowHighlight.title: Highlight when low
lowHighlight.description: Tint the battery icon and percentage with the attention color while the battery is low.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Workspace geometry, motion, and attention behavior.

activeWidth.title: Active width
activeWidth.description: Width of the active workspace pill.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Space on each side of a workspace indicator.

paddingX.title: Horizontal padding
paddingX.description: Space before and after the workspace row.

paddingY.title: Vertical padding
paddingY.description: Space above and below the workspace row; this also scales the bar height.

attentionPulseDuration.title: Attention pulse
attentionPulseDuration.description: Time in milliseconds for one fade direction of the attention pulse.

inactiveOpacity.title: Inactive opacity
inactiveOpacity.description: Opacity of workspace dots that are not active.

radius.title: Screen corners
radius.description: Radius of the display's corners. The bar's corners against the side edges are drawn to match it, so they read as the same shape.

liquid.title: Liquid
liquid.description: The merged distance field every shell surface is drawn into.

surfaceRadius.title: Surface corners
surfaceRadius.description: Corner radius of a surface's own free corners, the ones that touch nothing.

morphRadius.title: Contact radius
morphRadius.description: Requested radius for surface-to-surface and screen-edge joins, and the distance at which they start merging. Screen-edge joins are capped by surface thickness.

motionDuration.title: Open and morph
motionDuration.description: Default opening and morphing duration in milliseconds, or the spring's response time with spring motion on. Set to zero for immediate motion.

spring.title: Spring motion
spring.description: Move surfaces on a spring that keeps its speed when interrupted. Off, they follow a fixed curve.

bounce.title: Bounce
bounce.description: How far a spring overshoots and rebounds before settling.

deform.title: Deformation
deform.description: How much a moving surface stretches along its travel before settling.

deformContent.title: Deform content
deformContent.description: Stretch and squash a moving surface's content along with it. Off, only the outline stretches, outward along the travel, and the content stays rigid.

bulge.title: Bulge
bulge.description: How far the leading and trailing faces of a moving surface bow outward.

neck.title: Neck
neck.description: How much wider a moving surface's joins to the screen edge and other surfaces grow, as a share of the contact radius.

contentTravel.title: Content travel
contentTravel.description: How much of a drawer's travel its content follows. Lower values keep the content nearer its place while the surface grows over it.

contentFade.title: Content fade
contentFade.description: Fade and grow a surface's content in just after it starts opening, and fade it out first when it closes.

contentScale.title: Content grow
contentScale.description: How much smaller content starts while fading in, as a share of its size.

emergeWidth.title: Emerge width
emergeWidth.description: How wide a drawer is as it starts to come out of the edge, as a share of its full width. It widens to full size as it opens.

triggerEmergeWidth.title: Emerge width from a trigger
triggerEmergeWidth.description: How wide a drawer opened from a bar icon is as it starts to come out under that icon, as a share of its full width.

cornerEmerge.title: Corner emerge
cornerEmerge.description: How far a drawer in a screen corner, when not opened from a bar icon, starts inside the side edge as well, as a share of its emerging width, so it grows out of the corner.

stiffness.title: Spring stiffness
stiffness.description: How hard a deformed surface is pulled back to its resting shape.

damping.title: Spring damping
damping.description: How quickly the settling wobble dies out.

backdropOpacity.title: Opacity
backdropOpacity.description: Opacity of the dimmed backdrop behind modal drawers. At zero it is invisible but still catches outside clicks.

backdropBlur.title: Blur
backdropBlur.description: Blur the screen behind modal drawers. The blurred view is a still capture, so content behind a modal freezes until it closes.

backdropBlurRadius.title: Blur radius
backdropBlurRadius.description: How far the backdrop blur spreads, in logical pixels.

backdropCustomDuration.title: Custom timing
backdropCustomDuration.description: Animate the backdrop with its own duration. Off follows the modal drawer's opening animation.

backdropDuration.title: Duration
backdropDuration.description: Backdrop dimming and blur duration in milliseconds. Set to zero for an immediate change.

ui.title: Interface
ui.description: Shared interface typography and control sizing.

fontFamily.title: Text font
fontFamily.description: Font family for shell and settings text.

radius.title: Corner radius
radius.description: Shared corner radius for buttons, fields, rows, cards, and menus. Smaller icon tiles and larger cards are derived from it.

osd.title: OSD
osd.description: Visual behavior of passive on-screen readouts.

scrollDirection.title: Message scroll
scrollDirection.description: Direction used when successive OSD messages belong to the same cycle group.

enabled.title: Show notifications
enabled.description: Run the shell's notification server. Turn it off to use another one, such as swaync or dunst; the shell then restarts to free it.

x-ui.keywords: daemon server swaync dunst mako module

indicator.title: Unseen indicator
indicator.description: Show a bell beside the clock while there are notifications you have not seen in the center.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Played for a new notification that names no sound of its own. File plays the sound file below.

criticalSound.title: Critical sound
criticalSound.description: Played for a new critical notification that names no sound of its own.

soundFile.title: Sound file
soundFile.description: Path of the sound to play when a sound above is File.

normalTimeout.title: Popup time
normalTimeout.description: Seconds a notification stays up when its app leaves the timing to the shell. Critical ones stay until dismissed.

lowTimeout.title: Low priority popup time
lowTimeout.description: Seconds a low priority notification stays up when its app leaves the timing to the shell.

maxPopups.title: Popups at once
maxPopups.description: The most notifications popped up together; older ones wait in the center.

sounds.title: Play sounds
sounds.description: Play notification sounds, the ones apps ask for and the ones above.

historyLimit.title: Kept after restart
historyLimit.description: How many notifications the center keeps across restarts.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Mock system state and liquid lab parameters, edited in the debug panel of debug builds (MINISHELL_DEBUG=1).

mock.title: Mock values
mock.description: Show mocked Bluetooth, network, volume, and battery values on the bar instead of live system state.

bt.title: Bluetooth
bt.description: Mocked Bluetooth adapter state, or live values with auto.

net.title: Network
net.description: Mocked network state, or live values with auto.

netStrength.title: Wi-Fi strength
netStrength.description: Mocked Wi-Fi signal strength in percent.

volume.title: Output volume
volume.description: Mocked default sink volume in percent.

micVolume.title: Input volume
micVolume.description: Mocked default source volume in percent.

batteryPresent.title: Present
batteryPresent.description: Pretend a battery exists, even on machines without one.

liquidModalDismiss.title: Click away
liquidModalDismiss.description: Close the modal preview when clicking its backdrop. Outside clicks are consumed in either mode.

liquidCard.title: Show probe
liquidCard.description: Show the draggable deformation and field-fusion probe.

liquidStress.title: Show stress shapes
liquidStress.description: Add test shapes to exercise active-shape compaction and the eight-shape warning.

liquidDrawerEdge.title: Edge
liquidDrawerEdge.description: Display edge that the drawer slides from.

liquidDrawerAlignment.title: Alignment
liquidDrawerAlignment.description: Position along the selected edge. Start means left on horizontal edges and top on vertical edges; end means right or bottom.

liquidModalEdge.title: Edge
liquidModalEdge.description: Display edge that the modal drawer stays attached to.

liquidModalAlignment.title: Alignment
liquidModalAlignment.description: Position along the selected display edge.

liquidCardPosition.title: Position
liquidCardPosition.description: Initial screen position of the draggable deformation probe.

liquidStressCount.title: Shapes
liquidStressCount.description: Number of extra painted shapes used to verify the eight-shape shader capacity and warning behavior.
